title: CWA dashboard sources report
description: What each producer sent the assemblers in the current window and what became of it, from the events' snapshots and traces: the batches it sent, the items in them, the items admitted and the tokens they took, the items compressed, and the items excluded by reason and stage. A producer is its id and kind together, as the snapshot's batch names it (R-15). Nothing here is estimated: the contract records no cost for an excluded item, so the report has no tokens kept out.

window.description: The events the report covers: the current window of the index, by recorded_at, and how many events that is.

producers.description: One entry per producer, ordered by id, then kind.

kind.description: The batch's producer kind, one of the snapshot schema's.

events.description: Assembled or refused events with a batch from this producer.

submitted.description: The items in its batches, across those events.

admitted.description: Of those, the items the trace includes, each counted once per event.

compressed.description: Of those, the items the trace compressed.

included_tokens.description: The tokens its included occurrences took, as the traces count them (trace.included[].tokens).

excluded.description: Its items the traces exclude, by reason code and stage, in the contract's reason order.

rejected_events.description: Events whose snapshot was rejected before assembly and held a batch from this producer.
